edited_fraction: re-verified MIT edit: 130,188 entries in two matrices (8.1-10.6% Frobenius change); own recreation E3: 16 of 747 weights (2.14%)
cost_reported: re-reports the source: editor spent 158 turns and 20.3 hours on Experiment 8, while a scripted no-LLM pipeline re-derived a similar edit in about five CPU minutes; own decoding-control run stopped by compute billing
evidence_notes: WSP is the subject: an evidence review of the MIT post, small recreations with deterministic tools (no LLM editor; p.16) and a bit-exact re-verification of the released Qwen3.5-0.8B edit (p.4, p.12-13). Only the thinking-off decoding control has a pre-registered decision rule in the public Zenodo edition, and it was not run because billing stopped it (p.1, p.13-14), so prereg is partial. A no-LLM scripted pipeline matched about 75% of the edit and the edit follows the abliteration playbook (p.6). The E1-E4 scripts stay on the THOX build VM and are not released (p.~19). The planned decoding-control rows are listed as planned, not given numbers.
